role: The singleton "File IO Thread" that drains queued IThreadedFileIO writers (AnvilChunkLoader chunk saves) in the background. Carries two oracle hooks: under Oracle.active() queueIO hands the writer to netherite.oracle.ChunkIO (a chunk loader's saves are already queued there by AnvilChunkLoader.saveChunk's detach hook, so its queueIO is a no-op), and waitForFinish first settles ChunkIO.
scope_reason: Background disk writing is not game behavior: the oracle writes chunks through ChunkIO, which writes every save in save order from its own copy and lets a pending chunk load from a copy of its NBT, so chunk save/reload and the region files are deterministic, and the native engine keeps unloaded chunk state in memory rather than writing region files on a thread.

members.name: ThreadedFileIOBase
members.note: starts the File IO Thread at priority 1

members.name: queueIO
members.note: oracle hook: netherite.oracle.ChunkIO.queue takes the writer when Oracle.active() (a chunk loader: nothing to do, detach queued the save)

notes: The queueIO and waitForFinish hooks are one-line calls into netherite.oracle.ChunkIO (the vanilla background writer races chunk reloads; ChunkIO closes the race: every save is written in save order from its own copy, and settle waits for all of them). Not verified: whether csrc/engine/region.c or chunkload.c models the save point order explicitly; grep for ThreadedFileIO and queueIO in native found nothing.
